arxiv-2104-14542.creator: Maíra Dutra, Vinícius Oliveira, C. A de S. Pires, Farinaldo S. Queiroz
arxiv-2104-14542.description: Abstract We discuss a model where a mixed warm and hot keV neutrino dark matter rises naturally. We arrange active and sterile neutrinos in the same S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) L SU(3)_{L} multiplet, with the lightest sterile neutrino being dark matter.

arxiv-2205-02374.creator: Victor Lecomte, Prasanna Ramakrishnan, Li-Yang Tan
arxiv-2205-02374.description: Abstract We study the complexity of computing majority as a composition of local functions: Maj n = h ⁡ ( g 1 , … , g m ) , \Maj_{n}=h(g_{1},\ldots,g_{m}), where each g j : { 0 , 1 } n → { 0 , 1 } g_{j}:\{0,1\}^{n}\to\{0,1\} is an arbitrary function that queries only k ≪ n k\ll n

arxiv-2209-03715.title: Optimization-based framework for low-voltage grid reinforcement assessment under various levels of flexibility and coordination
arxiv-2209-03715.creator: Soner Candas 1 1 , Beneharo Reveron Baecker 1 , Anurag Mohapatra 2 , Thomas Hamacher 1
arxiv-2209-03715.description: Abstract The rapid electrification of residential heating and mobility sectors is expected to drive the existing distribution grid assets beyond their planned operating conditions. This change will also reveal new potentials through sector coupling, flexibilities, and the local exchange of decentralized generation.

arxiv-2308-02437.title: Noise removal methods on ambulatory EEG: A Survey
arxiv-2308-02437.creator: Sarthak Johari, Gowri Namratha Meedinti, Radhakrishnan Delhibabu, Deepak Joshi
arxiv-2308-02437.description: Abstract Over many decades, research is being attempted for the removal of noise in the ambulatory EEG. In this respect, an enormous number of research papers is published for identification of noise removal, It is difficult to present a detailed review of all these literature.

arxiv-2309-05107.title: Nonlinear Granger Causality using Kernel Ridge Regression
arxiv-2309-05107.creator: Wojciech “Victor” Fulmyk fulmykw@gmail.com
arxiv-2309-05107.description: Abstract I introduce a novel algorithm and accompanying Python library, named mlcausality , designed for the identification of nonlinear Granger causal relationships. This novel algorithm uses a flexible plug-in architecture that enables researchers to employ any nonlinear regressor as the base prediction model.

arxiv-2310-14576.title: Tensor Decomposition Based Attention Module for Spiking Neural Networks
arxiv-2310-14576.creator: Haoyu Deng, Ruijie Zhu, Xuerui Qiu, Yule Duan, Malu Zhang, Liang-Jian Deng
arxiv-2310-14576.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Haoyu Deng, Ruijie Zhu, Xuerui Qiu, Yule Duan, Malu Zhang, Liang-Jian Deng. A B S T R A C T The attention mechanism has been proven to be an effective way to improve the performance of spiking neural networks (SNNs). However, from the perspective of tensor decomposition to examine the existing attention modules, we find that the rank of the attention maps generated by previous methods is fixed at 1, lacking the flexibility to adjust for specific tasks.

arxiv-2310-15508.title: Spacetime surgery for black hole fireworks
arxiv-2310-15508.creator: Wei-Chen Lin a,b , Dong-han Yeom a,d,e,f , and Dejan Stojkovic c
arxiv-2310-15508.description: Abstract We construct an explicit model for the black hole to white hole transition (known as the black hole fireworks scenario) using the cut-and-paste technique. We model a black hole collapse using the evolution of a time-like shell in the background of the loop quantum gravity inspired metric. We then use the space-like shell analysis to construct the firework geometry.

arxiv-2411-04984.title: Planar Reflection-Aware Neural Radiance Fields
arxiv-2411-04984.creator: Chen Gao, Yipeng Wang, Changil Kim, Jia-Bin Huang, Johannes Kopf
arxiv-2411-04984.description: Abstract . Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in reconstructing complex scenes with high fidelity. However, NeRF’s view dependency can only handle low-frequency reflections. It falls short when dealing with complex planar reflections, often interpreting them as erroneous scene geometries and leading to duplicated and inaccurate scene representations.

arxiv-2501-07396.title: Zero-Shot Scene Understanding for Automatic Target Recognition Using Large Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2501-07396.creator: Yasiru Ranasinghe, Vibashan VS, James Uplinger, Celso De Melo, Vishal M. Patel
arxiv-2501-07396.description: Abstract Automatic target recognition (ATR) plays a critical role in tasks such as navigation and surveillance, where safety and accuracy are paramount. In extreme use cases, such as military applications, these factors are often challenged due to the presence of unknown terrains, environmental conditions, and novel object categories.

arxiv-2601-01054.title: Out-of-Band Power Side-Channel Detection for Semiconductor Supply Chain Integrity at Scale
arxiv-2601-01054.creator: Rajiv Thummala, Katherine Winton, Luke Flores, Elizabeth Redmond, Gregory Falco
arxiv-2601-01054.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Rajiv Thummala, Katherine Winton, Luke Flores, Elizabeth Redmond, Gregory Falco. Out-of-band screening of microcontrollers is a major gap in semiconductor supply chain security. High-assurance techniques such as X-ray and destructive reverse engineering are accurate but slow and expensive, hindering comprehensive detection for hardware Trojans or firmware tampering. Consequently, there has been increased interest in applying machine learning techniques to automate forensic examination, enabling rapid, large-scale inspection of components without manual oversight.

arxiv-2601-07566.title: Dynamic ( Δ + 1 ) (\Delta+1) Vertex Coloring
arxiv-2601-07566.creator: Noam Benson-Tilsen
arxiv-2601-07566.description: Abstract Several recent results from dynamic and sublinear graph coloring are surveyed. This problem is widely studied and has motivating applications like network topology control, constraint satisfaction, and real-time resource scheduling. Graph coloring algorithms are called colorers . In § 1 are defined graph coloring, the dynamic model, and the notion of performance of graph algorithms in the dynamic model.

Dengue virus (DENV) is a serious mosquito-borne pathogen causing significant global disease burden, either as classic dengue fever (DF) or in its most severe manifestation dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF). Nearly half of the world's population is at risk of dengue disease and there

pmc-10480195.title: Validation of prediction algorithm for risk estimation of intracranial aneurysm development using real-world data
pmc-10480195.creator: Tackeun Kim, Jisu Choi, Won-Ju Park, Seunghyeon Cho, Yeongjae Yoo, Hyeonjun Kim, Juhee Cho, Jin-Deok Joo, Chang Wan Oh
pmc-10480195.description: Intracranial aneurysm (IA) is difficult to detect, and most patients remain undiagnosed, as screening tests have potential risks and high costs. Thus, it is important to develop risk assessment system for efficient and safe screening strategy. Through previously published research, we have developed a prediction model for the incidence risk of IA using cohort observational data.

pmc-11370893.title: Disease-associated microbiome signature species in the gut
pmc-11370893.creator: Junhui Li, Paul W O’Toole
pmc-11370893.description: There is an accumulation of evidence that the human gut microbiota plays a role in maintaining health, and that an altered gut microbiota (sometimes called dysbiosis) associates with risk for many noncommunicable diseases. However, the dynamics of disease-linked bacteria in the gut and other body sites remain unclear.

pmc-11602532.title: The Unusual Clinical Presentation of Eosinophilic Gastroenteritis and Its Response to Mepolizumab: Two Case Reports
pmc-11602532.creator: Mahmoud A Kiblawi, Talha Malik, Mazin M Edan
pmc-11602532.description: Eosinophilic gastroenteritis (EGE) is a rare digestive disorder that affects individuals of all ages, characterized by eosinophilic infiltration in the stomach and intestines. Various risk factors contribute to EGE, and its pathogenesis remains poorly understood. The definitive diagnosis relies on histological examination of the involved gastrointestinal (GI) tract, revealing evidence of eosinophilic infiltration.

pmc-12500118.title: Appeals to shared suffering in the context of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict
pmc-12500118.creator: Lukas Reinhardt, Harvey Whitehouse, Gal Harpaz, Gal Harpaz, Gal Harpaz, Gal Harpaz
pmc-12500118.description: Shared suffering can bond groups together and motivate fighting and even dying for the group leading to vicious cycles of violence while the suffering of the outgroup is routinely overlooked. But could the power of shared suffering also be harnessed to reduce tensions?

pmc-12533026.title: Cognitive-inspired xLSTM for multi-agent information retrieval
pmc-12533026.creator: Li Liang, Huan Wang, Kai Wang
pmc-12533026.description: In the era of big data and complex information retrieval tasks, multi-agent systems play a crucial role in handling large-scale, complex queries across various domains. Traditional approaches, such as BERT, RoBERTa, and Transformer models, have been widely used in information retrieval.

pmc-12548132.title: A study on women in Turkish culture: the mediating role of psychological resilience in the association between perceived stress and spiritual well-being
pmc-12548132.creator: Özden Tandoğan, Eda Yakıt Ak, Haydar Kerem Hoşgör, Derya Gündüz Hoşgör
pmc-12548132.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). AimThis study aims to examine the mediating role of psychological resilience in the relationship between perceived stress and spiritual well-being among women. By focusing on a large sample of Turkish women, it provides one of the first quantitative insights into how cultural and spiritual traditions shape gender-specific coping mechanisms, thereby offering a novel contribution to the international literature on stress and spirituality.Materials and methodsA cross-sectional survey was conducted with 498 women residing in Istanbul.

pmc-12634541.title: The role of brain creatine in behavioral health conditions
pmc-12634541.creator: Ellie S. Han, James R. Yancey, Deborah A. Yurgelun-Todd, Douglas G. Kondo, Danielle J. Boxer, Perry F. Renshaw
pmc-12634541.description: Creatine, as a naturally occurring organic compound, has gained attention for its potential role in psychiatric health. The creatine kinase-phosphocreatine energy buffer system plays a crucial role in maintaining energy supply in the brain. Brain bioenergetic deficits, particularly those related to mitochondrial dysfunction, plays a critical role in the pathophysiology of psychiatric illnesses.

pmc-12688555.title: Proximal stent graft combined with distal bare stent vs. conventional thoracic endovascular aortic repair in the treatment of complicated Stanford type B aortic dissection: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12688555.creator: Peng Lin, Shouji Qiu, Chengkai Hu, Yuchong Zhang, Enci Wang, Fandi Mo, Weiguo Fu, Lixin Wang
pmc-12688555.description: BackgroundThe combination of a proximal stent graft (PSG) and a distal bare stent (DBS) has a number of advantages over standard thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR) in the treatment of complicated Stanford type B aortic dissection (TBAD). However, direct comparisons between these two treatment approaches remain limited.

pmc-13528333.title: Predicting the causes of unplanned reoperations using an AI-based multimodal system: a multicentre, multidepartmental study based on EMRs
pmc-13528333.creator: Luyuan Xie, Congpu Zhao, Xutong Tan, Pengyu Zhao, Xuan Gong, Shengyang Li, Qingni Shen, Tianyu Luan, Guochen Yan, Dan Wang, Jiong Zhou, Xiaojun Ma, Zhonghai Wu
pmc-13528333.description: ObjectiveUnplanned reoperations are widely recognised as key indicators of surgical quality and patient safety. Analysing the underlying causes of such reoperations is critical for guiding clinical decision-making and optimising patient management. Most existing studies relied on electronic medical records (EMRs) for simple retrospective analyses and focused exclusively on single-disease cohorts, limiting their generalisability.
